title: Roomier dashboard and Service hubs
summary: The dashboard and each Service hub now use the shared spacing rules, so sections and cards have more even, less cramped spacing.
changes: Space the dashboard welcome card, attention list, and service totals with the shared spacing values.,Give service total cards and Service hub quick links a little more room.,Remove a doubled gap under the Available plugins heading on Service hubs.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.40 line: a compatible layout polish with no behaviour change.
validation: php artisan test tests/Feature/LayoutSpacingSmokeTest.php tests/Feature/DashboardAttentionTest.php.,composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.,Local browser check of the dashboard and the APES CIC hub.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
